en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑story building with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, partly covered in climbing plants. The structure stands in a rural setting with trees, fields, and low hills in the background. A few small human figures appear near the right edge of the scene. Printed German text at the top right identifies the building and its location.
